T-001.Title: Malformed loose-event contract and both write boundaries

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `src/artifact/run-membership.ts` keeps the filename-derived read-only inventory entry for an existing-but-unparseable loose file — the filename-derived attributes `{id, task, kind}`, empty children, and no `root` field on the returned `LooseEvent` — and additionally exposes `LooseEvent.parseIssue` as `{ code: "xml.parse", message }`. A direct `listLooseEvents(bundle)` call returns the entry with that field set; `bun run ngrace cursor show --change C --path <root>` exits 0; and a root `bun run ngrace lint --path <root> --fail-on errors` exits 0 and reports no issue for the loose file. The final repository tests are added first and re-driven red on the committed base for behavioral reasons before the production change lands.

`src/grace-cursor.ts` refuses unparseable input through one shared local guard, `assertNoUnparseableLooseEvents`, invoked before any auto-open, `discarded`, or ledger write at **both** production write entry paths. Ordinary `bun run ngrace cursor fold` refuses a malformed closer (`run/2-T-001-terminal.xml` = `<broken` with a valid `opened`) and a malformed progress (`run/2-T-001-progress.xml` = `<broken` alongside a valid `opened` and a valid later `terminal`), exiting non-zero, naming the file and `xml.parse`, writing no `discarded` and no synthesized `opened`, and leaving the recursive project tree byte-identical. The control fixtures keep their measured directions: a valid closer folds at exit 0; a simply absent trailing file folds at exit 0; a parseable event with omitted attributes folds at exit 0; and a directory at the event path exits non-zero with `EISDIR` preserved and the path named.

The real `bun run ngrace supersede --change <pred> --replacement <succ>` path with an open epoch (valid `opened` + malformed `progress`, no closer) refuses before `discardAndFoldEpoch` writes `discarded`: exit non-zero, naming the file and `xml.parse`; no `*-discarded.xml`; the predecessor remains active and the replacement remains in place with unchanged statuses and bytes; the predecessor is not archived; and the recursive project tree (directory entries, symlinks, relative paths, per-file bytes) is byte-identical. `src/artifact/xml.ts` and `src/gates/ledger.ts` are not edited.
